description: Windah makes up a love song for Jason and Lucia ('kisah cinta dua sejoli… terpaksa melakukan kriminal, namun ini semua untuk anak mereka') during a home cutscene (idea E1). Stopped before 19:48:03 (the cutscene turns to a kiss on the floor and a pistol, t 971-979). Violence check: a pistol is handed over at t 947.5-950 and held at t 959-961, so the picture (source px x0-1500, the whole frame except the facecam column) is box-blurred for those two cuts; t 941-942 (pistol on the table) is outside the cuts. No swears. Main 26.45 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Clean layout as windah-gtavi-sepatu; hook line 1 Paper 'WINDAH BIKIN LAGU', line 2 Volt 'BUAT JASON DAN LUCIA', Audex 68. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio.
